s752_PP_r1:
Well done! "In" is correct because April is a month: in April, in July.

Now try a day. Write in or on:
My English lesson is ___ Friday.

Next one. Write in, on or at:

Write a few or a little:

Well done! Milk is uncountable, so we say "How much milk".

How ___ eggs do we need?

Last night he ___ me a story.
